attributes.name: [GCP Cloud Run OTel] Service availability 99.5% rolling 30 days
attributes.description: Tracks the share of requests served by each Google Cloud Run service that did not end in an HTTP 5xx response (application errors, OOM kills, startup failures, 503 infrastructure errors and 504 request timeouts). Good events are request_count where attributes.response_code_class is not 5xx; total events are all request_count across every response class. 4xx client errors count as good. The objective is 99.5% of requests over a rolling 30-day window, measured per service in each GCP project and region. Limitation: run.googleapis.com/request_count only counts requests that reached a container instance. HTTP 429s from the Cloud Run load balancer when max-instances is exhausted, and requests rejected before routing, are not counted, so this SLO is optimistic during scale-out saturation. Watch the active instance count and per-instance concurrency for a plateau under rising load, which signals the max-instances ceiling. Metrics are polled every 5 minutes and GCP adds up to about 2 minutes of visibility delay, so recent minutes can arrive late.
